title: WR-5: _resolve_date() truthiness documentation and test coverage
outcome: Phase 2 of world-review fixes complete. Added 5 new tests characterizing _resolve_date() truthiness behavior for empty strings, and added a documentation comment to the source explaining the intentional truthiness pattern. All 66 tests pass with zero regressions.
key_decisions: No code behavior change needed — the existing truthiness check (if since / if until) correctly handles both None and empty string by falling through to defaults
Added characterization tests to guard against future refactors that might switch to 'is not None' checks and break empty-string handling
Added a source-level comment documenting the truthiness intent so future maintainers understand the pattern
The documentation test reads the source file to verify a comment exists — this is a lightweight guardrail, not a runtime assertion
learnings: The plan's 'revised fix' correctly identified that no code change was needed — only documentation and test coverage

The initial documentation test had a false positive: checking for '""' in source matched triple-quote docstrings ("""), so I refined it to check for comment lines (starting with #) containing specific keywords
Characterization tests are valuable even when behavior is already correct — they prevent silent breakage from future refactors
